name: Georgian Dance (Foundation)
notes: Georgian Dance FOUNDATION pack (Doc 04 template) — a doorway pack in the bharatanatyam tradition: it teaches what can be honestly self-trained and hard-gates what cannot. Georgia's dance repertoire is one of the world's most spectacular — Kartuli's formal courtship duet where the man's eyes never leave his partner and his feet seem not to touch the ground, Acharuli's seaside mischief, Mtiuluri's mountain one-upmanship, Khorumi's war formation — carried to the world's stages by the SUKHISHVILI Georgian National Ballet (founded 1945 by ILIKO SUKHISHVILI and NINO RAMISHVILI, the husband-and-wife founders credited here by name) and by ERISIONI. The pack's central honesty gate is about the famous men's technique: Georgian male dancers perform on the KNUCKLES OF THEIR TOES — no blocks, no pointe shoes — plus aerial leaps and spinning knee drops, and ALL of it is stage technique built over years under masters with conditioning this app cannot supervise; meta.stage_honesty says so and hard-gates the vocabulary, and a scan test enforces that NO toe-work move exists in this tree (ballet's no-pointe rule, Georgian chapter). What IS honestly self-trainable is the foundation both registers share: the regal carriage, the women's floating glide (the 'gliding as if on wheels' svla), the arm lines (women's soft waves, men's proud angles), and doli-drum musicality — and that foundation is a real dance in itself. The doli's drive rides in this app's Rhythm Trainer.

seasons.finale: Film yourself marking the doli's drive — carriage tall, accents caught, the drum respected.
Film the Georgian carriage — regal spine, still head, proud calm — held through one full song of simple steps.
Film the floating glide — smooth small steps under a motionless upper body — crossing your room like water.
Film both arm registers — the soft flowing waves and the proud angular lines — distinct and unhurried.
Watch a full Sukhishvili or Erisioni performance, journal what the foundation makes possible, and find a Georgian teacher or ensemble class.

attributes.name: Regal carriage L2
attributes.test: 3 minutes of tall, still-headed, proud-calm posture through slow walking — the crown must not bob, tilt, or apologize

attributes.name: Glide feet L1
attributes.test: 60s of small smooth heel-to-ball steps with zero vertical bounce — a full glass on the head survives the crossing

nodes.name: The doli — the drive
checkpoints: Georgian dance runs on the DOLI — the double-headed drum whose driving patterns and sudden accents conduct every leap and glide; the drive is in this app's Rhythm Trainer
over it: the panduri's strum, the garmoni's reeds, and Georgia's famous polyphonic voices — a soundscape UNESCO honored before it honored almost anything else
learn the doli's two messages: the steady drive (carry) and the doubled crack (strike) — the whole repertoire answers those two words

nodes.name: The regional map
checkpoints: Georgia's repertoire is a map: KARTULI's formal courtship (the crown jewel), ACHARULI's seaside play, MTIULURI's mountain contest, KHORUMI's war formation — each region a different temperature
watch one example of each from Georgian ensemble footage and journal the temperature differences — the foundation you're training serves all of them
the music tells you which region you're in before the costumes do: Acharuli grins, Kartuli holds its breath

nodes.name: Sukhishvili & Ramishvili — the stagers
checkpoints: the SUKHISHVILI Georgian National Ballet — founded 1945 by ILIKO SUKHISHVILI and NINO RAMISHVILI, husband and wife — carried Georgia's dances to the world's great stages, with ERISIONI beside them; the staging generation is credited by name, as this app always credits it
the staged-vs-source discipline applies here too: the ballets are a spectacular INTERPRETATION of village and court traditions — study both registers and know which you're watching
Georgian studios and diaspora ensembles teach openly worldwide — the foundation this pack trains is exactly what their beginner classes expect

nodes.name: The stage gate — what this app will not teach
checkpoints: the famous men's technique — dancing on the KNUCKLES OF THE TOES with no blocks, the aerial leaps, the spinning knee drops — is STAGE TECHNIQUE built over years under masters, on conditioning this app cannot supervise: THIS PACK DOES NOT TEACH IT, and no node past this gate will
the reason is the ballet pack's reason: some vocabularies are gated by supervised training because the failure mode is injury, not embarrassment — honesty about that boundary IS the curriculum
what remains is not a consolation prize: the carriage, the glide, and the arm registers are the foundation every Georgian dancer builds on, and they are a complete dance

nodes.name: The regal carriage
nodes.anchor: the crown the whole repertoire wears
checkpoints: the Georgian silhouette: spine tall as a tower, chest open, chin level, head STILL — a calm so complete it reads as sovereignty
the stillness is active: the head rides one rail while everything travels beneath it — Kartuli's magic is 90% this
drill it walking, turning, and standing — the carriage must survive motion before any step vocabulary is worth adding
mistakes: performing intensity (Georgian dignity is calm, not glare — the power is in the stillness)

nodes.name: The floating glide
checkpoints: the women's signature (and every dancer's foundation): tiny smooth heel-to-ball steps under a motionless upper body — 'gliding as if on wheels', the floor apparently frictionless
the test is a full glass on the head, and it is not a metaphor: train with a book until the crossing is water
glide the geometries: straight lines, curves, the slow turn — Kartuli's partners orbit each other entirely on this engine
mistakes: visible steps (if the audience can count your feet, the glide isn't one yet — smaller, smoother, more)

nodes.name: The flowing register — waves & wings
checkpoints: the soft register: arms floating in slow waves — wrist leading, elbow following — hands blooming like the jeeb's Georgian cousin, framing but never touching the face
the waves ride OVER the glide without disturbing it: water above wheels
phrase to the melody, not the drum — this register answers the voices while the feet answer the doli

nodes.name: The proud register — angles & strikes
checkpoints: the sharp register: arms snapping to proud angular lines — one fist to the chest, one arm extended like a blade, elbows carving hard geometry on the doli's cracks
the strike is placed, then HELD: Georgian male lines are photographs, and the stillness between strikes is the frame
both registers belong to every learner here: train them as vocabulary, and let Georgian teachers assign tradition's roles when you reach a real class

nodes.name: Grounded step vocabulary
checkpoints: the floor-safe step layer: quick side-chasses, low sharp kicks, heel accents, and the traveling three-step — the grounded vocabulary the stage tricks decorate
steps answer the doli's cracks the way the arms do: drive carries, crack strikes — the whole body speaking one grammar
learn one eight-count from Georgian ensemble footage (Acharuli is the friendliest source), credit it, and keep it grounded — the gate stands
mistakes: reaching for toe-work or drops from video (the gate is a gate — the grounded layer is this pack's whole floor)

nodes.name: The foundation set — filmed
checkpoints: film one full song: carriage sovereign, glide crossing the frame, both arm registers shown distinct, one grounded eight-count from a credited source
the crown audit: watch the head's line across the whole video — one rail, zero bobs; the glass would have survived
say it on camera: Georgian dance, the Sukhishvili-Ramishvili staging lineage, and what the stage gate protects — the honesty is part of the set

nodes.name: The Georgian door
checkpoints: find a Georgian teacher: diaspora ensembles and studios teach worldwide, and the foundation you built here is exactly their beginner-class prerequisite
if the stage vocabulary calls you, it goes through them — supervised conditioning, real masters, years: the honest path this pack has pointed at from its gate onward
watch Sukhishvili live if they tour near you — knowing the foundation, you'll see the building differently
